# cork-search-common

A list of common searches, shown below the search form in the cork-header's search tray.
Add it as a child of a [`cork-search-tray`](../elements/cork-search-tray.md) in [`cork-header`](../elements/cork-header.md), alongside a [`cork-search-form`](../elements/cork-search-form.md).

## Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | `String` | Heading shown above the list. Default: 'Common Searches'. Attribute: heading. |

## Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | Links: a/button elements, or a ul/ol of li elements. Not an actual slot, but rather parsed and rendered into the shadow DOM by [`NavController`](../utils/controllers/NavController.md). See its examples for the markup formats. Only top-level items are shown. |

## Events

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cork-nav-item-click` | Fired when a rendered link or button is clicked, with the clicked item in detail.navItem. See [`NavController`](../utils/controllers/NavController.md). |

## Methods

### static get shadowRootOptions

Lit shadow root options. delegatesFocus forwards focus() on the element to its first focusable control,
e.g. when cork-search-tray is focused and has no form.

## Examples

**Import**

```js
import '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-search-common';

// or the class only, without registering the element:
import CorkSearchCommon from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-search-common/cork-search-common.js';
```

**Use**

```html
<cork-search-tray>
  <cork-search-form></cork-search-form>
  <cork-search-common heading="Popular Searches">
    <a href="/hours">Library hours</a>
    <a href="/print">How do I print?</a>
  </cork-search-common>
</cork-search-tray>
```
